text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — gateway-prod reporting sustained high 5xx rate (5m avg ~12%, threshold 2%). Paging oncall.

alice: got the page, I'm on it. starting triage.

ben: pulling gateway logs now, seeing bursts of upstream 502s to model-router between 10:12:02 - 10:18:30.

alice: any customer-facing reports? I can start comms after we know scope.

derek: support: yes — increased error noise on embeddings endpoint, one enterprise customer opened ticket #4521 (timeouts). They're seeing ~30% of requests erroring.

carmen: please collect correlation ids and head-of-log snippets. Ben: can you grab any X-Correlation-ID headers (we'll need them for traces)?

ben: pasting head of relevant logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z gateway-prod request_id=abc123 X-Correlation-ID=c1234 upstream=model-router status=502 "upstream_connect_failure"
2026-03-15T10:12:06Z gateway-prod request_id=abc124 X-Correlation-ID=c1235 upstream=model-router status=502 "upstream_response_timeout"
2026-03-15T10:12:07Z gateway-prod request_id=abc125 X-Correlation-ID=c1236 upstream=model-router status=504 "upstream_response_timeout"
```

ben: pattern looks like 502/504 from model-router. Gateway was configured to retry (3 retries) which amplifies load. I also see repeated retry attempts from same request ids.

mia: infra: model-router nodes spiked CPU 95% at 10:12:00Z. Autoscaler didn't add capacity — scaling stalled because replica drain time high after a config push at 09:58. KV cache miss rate jumped at same timestamp.

alice: hypothesis A: recent config push (09:58) invalidated caches -> model-router latency increased -> upstream timeouts -> gateway retries amplify failures.

carmen: hypothesis B: transient network/storage flapping affecting model-router access to KV store, causing timeouts. Need storage metrics and network logs to rule that out.

alice: mitigation plan: short circuit heavy retries at gateway, reduce retries to 0 for model-router route for 10m, and enable fast-fail 503 to avoid retry amplification. I'll push patch and monitor.

incident-bot: Deploy request queued: gateway-config patch by alice. Please acknowledge.

ben: ack. Applying change now.

ben: change applied at 10:22:11Z — retries disabled for model-router route. Immediate telemetry: 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 4% in the next 5m.

jeff: customer-ops: updating ticket #4521 with correlation ids c1234, c1235, c1236 and early mitigation details.

alice: running quick sanity checks on embedding throughput and latency. So far tail latency improving.

alice: timeline summary (preliminary):
- 09:58 config push to model-router (cache invalidation flag toggled)
- 10:12 model-router CPU and KV miss spike; upstream 502/504 seen by gateway
- 10:12-10:18 gateway 5xx elevated; retries cause amplification
- 10:22 gateway retry-policy tightened, short-circuit enabled

alice: immediate next steps: continue 30m monitoring, gather full request traces for correlation ids, upload raw logs and CPU/kv metrics to incident artifacts, and prepare RCA doc. If errors persist, plan rollback of 09:58 config.

derek: adding customer ticket links and error samples to the incident doc.

carmen: I'll start the RCA doc with a hypothesis matrix and required artifacts (logs, traces, autoscaler events, config diff).

alice: handing off deep-dive to ben. Please take ownership of timeline + post-incident report. @ben — over to you.

ben: taking over. I'll collect full traces for c1234/c1235/c1236, upload to /incidents/1775254321/artifacts, and draft the timeline + mitigation notes. Will also check autoscaler events and the config diff from 09:58.

incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to SEV-2 at 10:30:05Z — paging paused. :white_check_mark:
